en.purpose: To assess the histologic grade based on the FIGO grading for endometrioid adenocarcinoma.
en.misuse: Not to be used for grading other histological subtypes of endometrial cancer, such as serous or clear cell carcinomas.

other_details.references:
Soslow RA, Tornos C, Park KJ, Malpica A, Matias-Guiu X, Oliva E, Parkash V, Carlson J, McCluggage WG, Gilks CB. Endometrial Carcinoma Diagnosis: Use of FIGO Grading and Genomic Subcategories in Clinical Practice: Recommendations of the International Society of Gynecological Pathologists. Int J Gynecol Pathol. 2019 Jan;38 Suppl 1(Iss 1 Suppl 1):S64-S74. doi: 10.1097/PGP.0000000000000518. PMID: 30550484; PMCID: PMC6295928.

Nationellt vårdprogram livmoderkroppscancer [Internet]. Regionala cancercentrum i samverkan; [cited 2026 Jul 10]. Available from: https://kunskapsbanken.cancercentrum.se/diagnoser/livmoderkroppscancer/vardprogram/kategorisering-av-tumoren/
Pecorelli S. Revised FIGO staging for carcinoma of the vulva, cervix, and endometrium. Int J Gynaecol Obstet. 2009;105(2):103-4.
other_details.en: An assessment tool used to determine the histologic grade of endometrioid adenocarcinoma based on the proportion of solid growth and the presence of severe nuclear atypia.

pre_conditions: $gt0004|Notable severe nuclear atypia in more than 50% of the cells|!=null

when: $gt0004|Notable severe nuclear atypia in more than 50% of the cells|==local::at0011|Absent|

$gt0003|Glandular differentiation|.value==2||$gt0003|Glandular differentiation|==1|local::at0014|FIGO grade 1 - tumors ≤5%|&&$gt0004|Notable severe nuclear atypia in more than 50% of the cells|==local::at0012|Present|

$gt0003|Glandular differentiation|.value>=3||$gt0003|Glandular differentiation|==2|local::at0015|FIGO grade 2 - tumors from 6% to 50%|&&$gt0004|Notable severe nuclear atypia in more than 50% of the cells|==local::at0012|Present|

gt0001.description: An assessment tool used to determine the histologic grade of endometrioid adenocarcinoma based on the proportion of solid growth and the presence of severe nuclear atypia.

gt0004.text: Notable severe nuclear atypia in more than 50% of the cells

gt0008.text: Set risk assessment to high-grade, figo 3
gt0008.description: FIGO grade 3 or FIGO grade 2 with notable severe nuclear atypia

gt0011.text: Set risk assessment to low-grade , figo 2
gt0011.description: FIGO grade 1 or FIGO grade 2 without notable severe nuclear atypia

gt0016.text: Set risk assessment to low-grade , figo 1
gt0016.description: FIGO grade 1 without notable severe nuclear atypia
